page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides dedicated CPU allocation without resource sharing.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. It lacks integrated GPU acceleration and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Hardware capability flags indicate the absence of advanced vector extensions (AVX, AVX-512), matrix extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography (AES, SHA) instructions, which limits its efficiency for specialized mathematical, machine learning, or cryptographic workloads.

From a resource density perspective, the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers a balanced hardware profile for basic utility tasks. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable compute performance for workloads that do not require specialized instruction sets. This profile is suitable for lightweight web serving, small databases, basic application hosting, and general-purpose development or testing environments.
